body.x: Realtruewill work with the Daejeon Information Culture Industry Promotion Agency in MIKINNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT '(BOOTH # 52843) at CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, theworld's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, from January 8 (Tue),January 11 (Fri) to introduce' BALANSCALE ', a weight and body compositionanalyzer.

Founded in 2016, Realtrue is committed to human-related research and development. Realtrue's 'BALANSCALE' is a body weight analyzer. Anyone can easily measure his or her body center point and prevent disease caused by body type imbalance.

Itprovides content that protects the user's health, rather than simply measuringweight, so it can be used in sports, clothing, medical, and other fields. Anofficial of Realtrue said, "In 2019, we plan to launch BALANSCALE productsofficially," he said. "We aim to occupy about 5% in domestic skin /body management market."

"We plan to participate in CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas in January to advance into the US market." "We would like to try the crowd funding service 'Kickstarter'." In addition, he said, "We are going to actively enter Southeast Asian markets such as Vietnam, Indonesia and Singapore besides the United States."
